basic_info.description: Refined Noe Valley Victorian. Perched gracefully above the city on one of Noe Valley's most coveted blocks, 4121 23rd Street is a rare fusion of timeless San Francisco charm and modern sophistication. The home's facade hints at its classic Victorian lineage, while inside, light-filled interiors have been reimagined for contemporary living. The main level is anchored by the light-filled, south facing living room with vaulted ceiling and stairs to the yard. The chef's kitchen features a large island with room for seating, equally suited to everyday living and elevated entertaining. The elegant dining room features a fireplace flanked by custom cabinetry.  The upper-level bedrooms are framed by leafy outlooks, including a primary suite that functions as a true retreat with ensuite bath and generous closet space. Flexible garden-level rooms invite use as a home office, media lounge, or guest quarters - designed with both elegance and utility in mind. South-facing bright backyard offers room for seating and entertaining with built-in bench and mature plants and trees. Walking distance to restaurants and stores of 24th Street, this residence offers not only a home but a lifestyle: an urban sanctuary where architecture, neighborhood, and nature are perfectly in balance. 96 walk score.
